name: Linh Ung Pagoda, Son Tra
summary: Ride out to the peninsula for the view, then walk up to Linh Ung. The 67-meter Quan The Am faces the sea. Allow half a day, because the ride is the visit, and check the entry rule when you arrive.
timeNeeded: Half a day with the ride
getThere: Northeast of the Han River, on the Son Tra peninsula. Go by car or Grab. The Hai Van road continues north from this side of the city.
